def solve(n, b):

    total_sum = sum(b)
    if total_sum % n != 0:
        return "NO"
    
    # Calculate the common value a_i for all singers
    a_i = total_sum // n
    
    # Check if all durations can be achieved with a_i
    for duration in b:
        if duration % (n + 1) != 0:
            return "NO"
    
    return "YES\n" + " ".join(str(a_i) for _ in range(n))

t = int(input())

# Process each test case
for _ in range(t):
    # Read the number of cities
